​


**Basic Materials Conference**


Mark Costa, Board Chair and Chief Executive Officer, Eastman Chemical Company (NYSE:EMN), will address the Deutsche Bank 17th Annual Basic Materials Conference on June 3, 2026, at 9:25 a.m. ET.


**Live webcast**


****


Mr. Costa’s presentation will be webcast live on[investors.eastman.com](https://investors.eastman.com/) .


**Replay**


****


An audio replay of the presentation will be available at[investors.eastman.com](https://investors.eastman.com/overview/default.aspx) under events & presentations.
